serial.request_policy: wait exactly pmul_service_contract_cycles after the accepted background PMUL start response, then issue all HMATCH requests

interleaved.request_policy: issue HMATCH requests immediately after background PMUL start response

measurement.start_event: first cycle after accepted background PMUL start response
measurement.end_event: the frozen scenario window expires: 337853 cycles for SERIAL or 200144 cycles for INTERLEAVED
measurement.completion_validation: all 1632 HMATCH responses must occur within the frozen window; PMUL status and result are checked immediately after activity capture stops and are excluded from the measured interval
core_cycle_reference_applies_to: ASIC gate simulation using the same hdec_top interface
measurement.board_rule: board or CPU-integrated cycles are measured, not forced to the core reference, because wrapper and software overhead are part of that endpoint; the default PMUL wait value requires CPU rdcycle and HDEC to use the same ungated clock and must otherwise be calibrated
measurement.board_energy_window: integrate physical board energy from marker timestamps only; rdcycle is a separate system-cycle window and is not substituted for marker duration
measurement.board_idle_reference: CLOCKED_IDLE_SPIN using the same bitstream, firmware, clock settings and named rails

comparison_invariants: same VV35 RTL or same generated netlist for serial and interleaved runs
same vector bundle and file hashes
same PMUL and HMATCH operation counts
same clock, voltage, process or FPGA image
only request release timing may differ

evidence_labels.fpga_board: board-level measured power for the named rails and measurement setup
evidence_labels.asic_postlayout_px: post-layout ASIC power estimate when extracted parasitics and PrimeTime PX are available
